note_on_recursion: The plan cannot contain its own commit hash. This protocol is the authoritative digest-bearing freeze artifact; the plan's digest above is over its canonical LF text.

roadmap_amendments.AMENDMENT_1_STAGE_24_OPENING_RULE: Stage 24 may open under ROLE_B_PRIMARY_GEN1 after this plan, its audit, its digest and its handoff are complete. This is an explicit claim-architecture revision. It is NOT a Stage-23 PASS and it changes no historical Role-A verdict.
roadmap_amendments.AMENDMENT_2_GEN1_COMPLETION_PATH: Independent new-system replication moves from a Generation-1 publication gate to Generation 2. Stage 26 receives a known-treatment-only scoped limit; Stage 27 external replication and Stage 28 broad calibration/OOD claims become future work rather than prerequisites for the first paper.

dataset_firewall.rewind_evidence_well: CLOSED -- all usable GSE227151 replicates have influenced diagnosis, confirmation or the decision record

models.definitions_source: loaded and asserted equal to the frozen Stage-23 protocol/results; never retyped from memory

ranking_population_rule.rule: >=1 C1-positive condition AND >=1 C1-zero condition AND all six frozen OOF scores present for both W4 and W5
ranking_population_rule.derivation: 1401 clones; 929 detected in >=1 condition; 37 detected in all 6; 929 - 37 = 892 recomputed directly from stage22_wm989_clone_treatment.csv

bootstrap_contract.resampling_unit: eligible clone, all six condition rows kept together
bootstrap_contract.declared_asymmetry: conditional on the fitted models; the permutation null refits the whole pipeline, this interval does not

permutation_contract.type: full-refit expression permutation, Stage-23 WM989 geometry
permutation_contract.strata: depth bin {1,2,3-4,5-9,10+} x 3-bit naive-sample presence pattern, with the Stage-23 V2 deterministic small-stratum merge rule
permutation_contract.boundary: profiles permuted within stratum separately on each side of the outer train/test boundary; never across it
permutation_contract.sharding: each shard writes its OWN cache file; draw b seeded from a function of b alone; the merge asserts every index in 0..999 is present before any statistic is computed

compute_budget.measured_precedent: Stage 23E, WM989 C1, 200 full-refit draws, 335.03 min

reproduction_gate.primary: byte-identical regeneration of stage23_wm989_detection_oof.csv and stage23_wm989_interaction_oof.csv
reproduction_gate.fallback: ROW-LEVEL only. There is no pooled-metric route.
reproduction_gate.R1_shape_and_key: 8406 rows each; identical ordered (clone_id, treatment, outer_fold, y) tuples
reproduction_gate.R2_every_score: |regenerated - frozen| <= 1e-12 for every prediction cell of every model column; checked cell by cell, no aggregate substitute
reproduction_gate.R3_within_clone_ordering: for all 1401 clones, and for W4 and W5 independently, sign(s_iu - s_iv) unchanged for every condition pair, including tie structure
reproduction_gate.R4_cause_named: specific environment difference identified; 'floating point' alone is not a cause
reproduction_gate.failure: INPUT-INTEGRITY STOP -- permits only a correctness repair to the frozen W5 implementation

STAGE_25_RANKING_SUPPORTED_requires_all: delta_TOP1 >= 0  (directional-consistency check, not a significance test)
all integrity, leakage and determinism checks pass
verdict_logic.terminal: neither verdict returns the project to Stage 22, 23, 23.2, 23.5 or 24

recorded_relaxation.classification: LIMITED RELAXATION of the secondary consistency boundary, not a clarification
recorded_relaxation.admits: exactly one additional outcome -- delta_TOP1 exactly zero. The statistic is a difference of two means of binary indicators over 892 clones, so it lives on a grid of 1/892 and exact zero is attainable, not measure-zero.
recorded_relaxation.accompanying_reclassification: labelling it a directional-consistency check rather than a significance criterion removes an internal contradiction and moves no boundary

forbidden_rescue_actions: changing treatment direction or tie handling
dropping Cisplatin because its interaction is negligible
using C2 or a per-treatment result to rescue failed C1 ranking
any post-result plan revision for Generation 1
